program: anneal.c (gcc -O2 anneal.c -o anneal -lm); usage: anneal N m Tmax mode steps seed [T0]
complex: product cell complex of I^N, L = 6m+1 cells per coordinate, walls at cells 2m and 4m; delta = usc closure of a random cell labelling in {0..Tmax}

modes.1: (S) bad component: number of coordinates not spanned > t

score: sum over level components of the violation; score 0 would be a counterexample (all components bad)
conclusion: No counterexample to (S), (T) or (B) found; best score 1 throughout. Search evidence only.
